risks.risk: Hidden damage or weakness (wobbly frame, broken shelf supports, loose joints) not visible because items are covering parts of the structure.
risks.proof: A short video showing the wardrobe being pushed gently from different sides and each shelf edge tapped/checked for wobble, plus close-ups of joints and shelf corners.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially not fully sturdy (worst case: needs repair/parts).

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete setup (e.g., missing hanging rail, missing shelf panels, missing screws/anchors).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full wardrobe from the front and both sides with all shelves empty, showing every compartment and the hanging rail.

risks.risk: Surface condition issues (water stains, termite holes, cracks, peeling finish) that are not clearly visible with clothes inside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame surfaces, especially bottom panels, shelf edges, and any corners for cracks/stains/holes.

risks.risk: Size/fit risk (too small/large for the buyer’s space) because no dimensions are provided.
risks.proof: Photos with a measuring tape (height, width, depth) or a clear measurement sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average size with no guarantee of fit.

proof_requests: Send 3–5 photos with the wardrobe empty: front, left side, right side, and top view (if possible).
Provide dimensions (height/width/depth) with a measuring tape in the photo.
Send a short video testing stability: push test + shelf support check.
Close-ups of joints, shelf corners, and any bottom areas for cracks/termite/water damage.
response.reason: The item type is clear (open shelved wardrobe with hanging space), but key factors that affect resale value—condition, completeness, stability, and exact size—are not verifiable from the single photo with items inside. Proof is needed before a safe price.
